name: chain_render_bridge
summary: Godot 4 autoload that polls godot_ssot_proxy (:8766) every 3s, pulls /chain/renders/recent, downloads new PNGs to user://chain_render_cache/, and emits render_arrived(crystal_short, image_path, manifest) for scenes to consume. Also fans out chain events from /chain/events/recent and loads /chain/programs/watchset at startup. Pull-only — no SSE; HTTPRequest in Godot 4 doesn't stream cleanly. Bearer token resolved from @export var → MSPC_GODOT_BEARER env → ~/.cc/godot_dev_token.txt (issued via cc godot-issue-dev-token).

signals.event_arrived: (event: Dictionary)  — fresh chain event from program_monitor
signals.watchset_loaded: (entries: Array)  — program registry watchset (one-shot at start)

scene_consumer.demo: studio/godot/project/scenes/chain_render_wall.tscn (3D wall of textured Sprite3D tiles, color-modulated by dim_pack.rgba, with category+action+crystal labels, auto-orbit camera)

smoke_test_2026_05_29.auth_path: freetier token issued via cc godot-issue-dev-token, stored at ~/.cc/godot_dev_token.txt

five_canonical_frames_per_arrived_render.rgb: manifest.dim.rgba — Sprite3D.modulate is set to Color(r,g,b,1.0)

inbound_callers: any Godot scene that connects to ChainRenderBridge.render_arrived
future: morph_game_runtime scenes can tint avatars by chain event color

cc_dispatchers: cc godot-issue-dev-token        — write 30-day freetier token to ~/.cc/godot_dev_token.txt
cc godot-chain-smoke             — curl the 4 new /chain/* endpoints (debug)
cc godot-chain-wall              — launch chain_render_wall.tscn in Godot (requires Godot binary)
